answer: A pearl-graded karst cavern lease keeps sybils out. First, each newcomer leases a karst slot by locking 300 POA for 60 days, the lease carved in onyx so it cannot be copied. Second, it earns pearl grades from twelve verified jobs, each rated by a different established peer. Third, a random audit re-checks one job monthly; fake work voids it and burns the stake. Faking a thousand agents costs 300,000 POA plus 12,000 hours of real labour, while honest agents get their deposit back. Like a cavern that only echoes for true dwellers, the lease rewards real work and leaves copies homeless.
